description: This file implements a comprehensive memory management system for the AgentField SDK, including classes for memory clients, scoped memory, global memory, and a developer-facing memory interface with support for hierarchical scope management, vector similarity search, and event subscriptions.

classes.name: MemoryClient
classes.description: Handles low-level HTTP operations for memory management, including setting, getting, deleting, and searching memory data with support for scoping.

classes.name: ScopedMemoryClient
classes.description: Provides scoped memory operations within a specific scope and scope ID, including event subscription.

classes.name: GlobalMemoryClient
classes.description: Manages memory operations in the global scope, with event subscription capabilities.

classes.name: MemoryInterface
classes.description: Developer-facing API for memory operations, offering automatic scope management, hierarchical lookup, and explicit scope access.

methods.name: MemoryClient._build_headers
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with execution context and scope information.

methods.name: MemoryClient.set
methods.description: Stores a memory value with optional scope, serializing data as JSON.

methods.name: MemoryClient.set_vector
methods.description: Stores a vector embedding with optional metadata.

methods.name: MemoryClient.get
methods.description: Retrieves a memory value with hierarchical lookup, decoding JSON if necessary.

methods.name: MemoryClient.exists
methods.description: Checks if a memory key exists.

methods.name: MemoryClient.delete
methods.description: Deletes a memory key.

methods.name: MemoryClient.delete_vector
methods.description: Deletes a stored vector.

methods.name: MemoryClient.list_keys
methods.description: Lists all keys in a given scope.

methods.name: MemoryClient.similarity_search
methods.description: Performs a similarity search against stored vectors.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.set
methods.description: Sets a value within a specific scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.get
methods.description: Gets a value within a specific scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.exists
methods.description: Checks key existence within a scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.delete
methods.description: Deletes a key within a scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.list_keys
methods.description: Lists all keys in a scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.set_vector
methods.description: Stores a vector within a scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.delete_vector
methods.description: Deletes a vector within a scope.

methods.name: ScopedMemoryClient.similarity_search
methods.description: Performs a similarity search within a scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.set
methods.description: Sets a value in the global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.get
methods.description: Gets a value from the global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.exists
methods.description: Checks key existence in global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.list_keys
methods.description: Lists all keys in global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.set_vector
methods.description: Stores a vector in global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.delete_vector
methods.description: Deletes a vector in global scope.

methods.name: GlobalMemoryClient.similarity_search
methods.description: Performs a similarity search in global scope.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.set
methods.description: Sets a memory value with automatic scope resolution.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.set_vector
methods.description: Stores a vector with automatic scope resolution.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.get
methods.description: Retrieves a memory value with hierarchical scope lookup.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.exists
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in any scope.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.delete
methods.description: Deletes a key from the current scope.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.delete_vector
methods.description: Deletes a vector from the current scope.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.similarity_search
methods.description: Performs similarity search across stored vectors.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.session
methods.description: Returns a scoped memory client for a specific session.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.actor
methods.description: Returns a scoped memory client for a specific actor.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.workflow
methods.description: Returns a scoped memory client for a specific workflow.

methods.name: MemoryInterface.global_scope
methods.description: Provides access to the global memory scope.
